messages:
marco-ml: quick flag — onboarding evals for q6b-int8-cand show a stable drop on the longprompt 'multi-event summary' slice (~5.5 rougeL). noticed after we applied the recent semantic dedupe.

alejandra-curation: thanks for the heads up. which promptset and dedupe params were used? could be we removed paraphrase anchors.

marco-ml: promptset longprompt_aug_v1 (14.7k examples). dedupe run with semantic threshold 0.82 and cheap jaccard pass 0.9 last Friday. seed file attached.

sam-labelops: if anchors got removed that were used to craft golds, relabeling a focused microgolden makes sense. i can prep a 400-example batch (200 golden / 200 review) if we confirm. need +420 label units.

devon-eng: before we burn labels, let's isolate whether it's quant numeric drift vs gold corruption. i'll run an A/B only on the failing slice and pin decoding + kernel flags.

marco-ml: eval command i ran: 
```bash
python eval/run_eval.py --model q6b-int8-cand --dataset datasets/longprompt_aug_v1.jsonl \
  --slice multi_event_summary --metric rougeL --batch 12 --seed 13 --decoding beam=4
```

infra-bot: deploy note: q6b-int8-cand built 2024-06-30T10:12:00Z. perf 540 tok/s, KV 1.05GB/slot.

alejandra-curation: plan proposal: (A) sample microgolden 400 by event-count and paragraph-length (preserve any near-dupes removed by dedupe into a restore list), (B) run A/B baseline(fp16) vs candidate on that microgolden, (C) if A/B gap persists, proceed with relabel + short quant calibration sweep.

sam-labelops: prepping relabel instructions: tag LEVELS: TRUNC (missing tail), ORDER (timeline wrong), HALL (invented), COMP (compression loss). will include span highlights + examples.

devon-eng: spinning up A/B job now, pinning kernels and turning off auto-batching to eliminate scheduling variance. will also run forced-fp16 math path.

marco-ml: i'll attach 60 failing examples + 60 matched controls to the thread for quick eyeballing. :eyes:

infra-bot: AB test scheduled: ab-longprompt-2743211111, shards=6. expected runtime ~70m.

alejandra-curation: opened tracker RDW-9031 and uploaded sampling seeds + dedupe-restore whitelist. linking to relabel plan in the ticket.

sam-labelops: label quota request submitted (+420). will hold start until AB result. adding burnout guard and short QA spotcheck.

devon-eng: AB results posted: baseline (q8b-fp16) > q6b-int8-cand on multi_event_summary by 5.3 rougeL (p=0.004). token-diff traces: /evals/ab-longprompt-2743211111/token_diffs.tar.gz

marco-ml: that's pretty convincing. recommend running microgolden relabel + quant calibration (importance-weight long contexts) in parallel.

alejandra-curation: agreed. i'll expand golden by +300 anchors targeted at multi-event edgecases and trigger relabel after sam confirms queue.

sam-labelops: starting the 400-example relabel now. ETA artifacts ~42h. posting intermittent QA snippets to RDW-9031. :white_check_mark:

devon-eng: i'll also start a compact kernel bisect to see if particular int8 ops correlate with divergence; will post results here.

alejandra-curation: action items recap: (1) devon post bisect findings, (2) sam attach gold artifacts and track relabel QA, (3) marco run post-relabel regression harness, (4) infra keep ab logs linked.

marco-ml: thanks team. will run full regression once labels land and report back with rollout recommendation.
